entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have a problem with an order. I bought this jersey a while ago, and I'm just so confused. The website had a lot of information and I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do.
I can certainly help clear that up for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not damaged. It's just the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride and it's way too tight, I can barely move in it. I feel a bit overwhelmed by the return process. I just want to exchange it. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can definitely help you with that. A sizing issue is no problem at all. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the jersey was delivered about 50 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure what the rule was. I got so confused looking for the policy.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. Our standard return policy for apparel is 90 days from the date of delivery. Since you're at day 50, you are well within the window to make an exchange for the correct size.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can get a different size?

Absolutely. I can start that exchange process for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label to send back the jersey that's too tight, and we can get the new size sent out to you immediately. Does that sound good?
Yes, that sounds wonderful. Thank you so much, Diana. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. I'm happy we could get this sorted out for you. The email with the label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
